To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the synthesis and incorporation of proteins into the liver plasma membranes is not instantaneous, but occurs at a rate of about 10% per hour, and that the rate of incorporation of the proteins does not vary with the rate of synthesis.
the synthesis of plasma membrane proteins is a slow and gradual process that begins several hours before the proteins are built into the membrane.
newly-formed proteins are first assembled into complex units, which then mix with a soluble precursor membrane, and are subsequently incorporated into the plasma membrane.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the synthesis and assembly of the proteins of the plasma membrane.
the synthesis of the plasma membrane.
the synthesis of the liver cell membrane.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
proteins are synthesized in the cytoplasm, and then, at some time, are incorporated into the plasma membrane.
the liver cell synthesizes its plasma membrane in a step-wise fashion, and that it is not yet possible to decide which of the four possibilities is the correct one.
the plasma membrane of liver cells is built by the assembly of protein units into a complex membrane structure.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the plasma membrane is a mosaic of proteins, each of which is synthesized independently of the others and each of which may be added to the membrane at different times during its life.
the liver plasma membrane is synthesized by the assembly of new proteins into the membrane.

we have demonstrated a time lag between the formation of a protein and its incorporation into the plasma membrane, and have also demonstrated a time lag in the incorporation of the newly-formed protein into a soluble pool.
The main takeaway from our work is that
proteins are not incorporated directly into the membrane but must first pass through the soluble pool.
the liver plasma membrane is a dynamic structure that is constantly being remade from its component parts.
the plasma membrane of a liver cell is constantly being replaced by newly-synthesized proteins.
